Two basketball courts. That's how much wing one Airbus A380 has. 🏀

Together, the A380's wings cover 845 m². An official FIBA basketball court measures 28 × 15 m, or 420 m². So one superjumbo carries two full courts' worth of wing, with 5 m² to spare. Tip to tip, the wingspan is 79.8 m, longer than the aircraft itself.

Upper deck or lower deck: where would you sit? 👇
